display_revisit.initial_display_observation: First explicit original-detail display appeared as a very small grey fragment, insufficient for complete native-detail inspection; no native raw transcription was inferred from that display.
display_revisit.resolution: One revisit of the same pinned original displayed the entire 1672x941 image; complete glyph and edge inspection then became possible. Raw first transcription from usage720 is retained unchanged.
display_revisit.reason: Incomplete original-detail display, not an observed native-image failure.

located_observations.observation: Three substantial cutout encounters fill and shape the frame: conversation above, a violin/listening pair lower left, and a closer salad exchange at right. Shared cups, clothing colors and faces connect these as one ordinary gathering.

Large encounter silhouettes remain the main masses. Date at upper left and central identity are immediate readable anchors; contours lead to access beside music and admission/cup/lingering information beside food. This is not a subordinate-photo headline/footer arrangement.

All eleven entries are readable. Dark rounded sans captions sit on light grey openings, and no caption crosses faces, cups, salad or the instrument. Read route used: date/hours, venue/early entry at left, central identity/theme, admission beside bowl, cup advice and lingering below; invitation is separately visible above conversation.

Hangul proportions and counters remain open and regular, with clear spaces between supplied words. Every copy entry occupies one line; the soft wrapping and two-line title suggested in the plan were not necessary.

located_observations.location: upper middle and lower-left cup grips
located_observations.observation: Hands contact the cup bodies with plausible finger/thumb separation. The upper pair look toward each other, and the lower listener faces the violin player.
The neck, pegs, body and strings are recognizable; fingering hand is on the neck and bow crosses the strings. The player and listener are seated and share scale locally.

A large bowl contains radish rounds and green salad. An orange-sleeved hand supports its left edge, and the receiving person's hands support its front/right edge. The selectively cut forearm does not show its whole route to the woman's torso.

Clean masked photographic outlines retain hair, knit and facial detail with simplified olive shadows and warm skin highlights. There are no pasted rectangles, room planes, invented logos, QR marks or decorative pseudo-print.

text.unicode_limitation: Raster reading reports visible glyph classes; it does not authenticate encoded Unicode code points.

style.checked_requirement: Substantial distributed photographic cutout encounters with contour-paired information, anonymous adult food/music/conversation, olive/cool grey/orange finish.
style.observed: Unequal upper conversation, lower-left listening and close right serving situations organize local caption openings. Central title is a single line, larger than proposed, but still embedded inside the three image masses. Multiple photographic tonal gradations remain.
style.basic_exclusion_observation: Images organize the full page through contour openings and content-based paired captions; no passive title/date/information panel with little subordinate pictures is observed.

ratio.policy: Nearest-integer rounding of one native edge <=0.5 pixel allowed

no_type_only.evidence: Conversation with cups, violin playing/listening and supported spring salad exchange are large meaningful actions, not tiny decorative glyphs or icons.

information_relationship.observed: Date/hours and access share left edge, music anchors access, center holds identity/theme, food anchors admission and visiting habits. All required visitor choices are findable at usage720.

contact_function.observed: Cup contact, violin bow/string relation and hands supporting bowl edges are visible; orange-sleeved serving arm's full route to torso is hidden by selective cutout.
contact_function.limitation: No claim that an actual photographic provenance or functional musical performance was verified.

identity.observed: Ordinary anonymous adults; no identifiable business, named performer, logo, watermark or QR observed.

material_edge_finish.observed: Photographic hair and clothing edges remain crisp; posterized olive shadows simplify surfaces without texture filler or room mockup.

residuals.location: right serving group, orange forearm below bowl
residuals.observation: Selective cutout hides part of the serving arm's connection to the woman's torso; bowl support itself is legible.
Ancillary information requires the usage720 view, where it was read; thumbnail is only a composition check.
Skin and fabric retain more tonal gradation than the advisory two-to-three-step plan; no repair is warranted solely to match that plan.

selection_decision.reason: Exact visible copy and practical reading work at usage720, the three substantive encounters organize the whole and preserve the assigned image/caption system. No observed copy or reading defect, materially wrong ratio, prohibited overall template, or obvious functional structural failure requires a native repair.
